actions.code: const x={{ json . }}; if(typeof x.proposal_id!=="string" || !/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$/.test(x.proposal_id)) throw new Error("invalid_slug"); if(x.review_note!=null&&(typeof x.review_note!=="string"||x.review_note.length>4000)) throw new Error("invalid_review_note"); if(x.confirmation_manuelle!=="oui") throw new Error("manual_confirmation_required"); if(!["validated","refused","disputed"].includes(x.decision)) throw new Error("invalid_decision"); return {proposal_id:x.proposal_id,decision:x.decision,review_note:x.review_note||"",confirmation_manuelle:true,review_id:x.proposal_id+"-review"};

const p0={{ json .proposal_file }}; let p; try{p=typeof p0==="string"?JSON.parse(p0):JSON.parse(p0.content||JSON.stringify(p0))}catch(e){throw new Error("proposal_invalid")} if(p.proposal_id!==(({{ json .review }}).proposal_id)||typeof p.source_id!=="string"||!/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$/.test(p.source_id)||p.status!=="proposed") throw new Error("proposal_corrupt_or_mismatch"); return p;

const p={{ json .proposal }}; const s0={{ json .source_file }}; const s=typeof s0==="string"?JSON.parse(s0):JSON.parse(s0.content||JSON.stringify(s0)); if(s.source_id!==p.source_id||typeof s.content!=="string"||!s.content.includes(p.evidence_quote)) throw new Error("evidence_or_source_mismatch"); return {evidence_quote:p.evidence_quote,source_id:p.source_id};

const fs={{ json .files }}; const r={{ json .review }}; const p="/company-memory/review-"+r.proposal_id+".json"; if(!Array.isArray(fs)) throw new Error("storage_listing_unavailable"); if(fs.some(f=>f&&f.path===p)) throw new Error("final_review_already_exists"); return {path:p};

const r={{ json .review }}; const e={{ json .evidence }}; return {review_id:r.review_id,review_note:r.review_note,proposal_id:r.proposal_id,decision:r.decision,confirmation_manuelle:true,reviewed_at:new Date().toISOString(),evidence_quote:e.evidence_quote,source_id:e.source_id};
